kickoff.label: HNSW graph + int8 vectors

kickoff.label: ANN data nodes

kickoff.label: Query-encoder L4s (N+1)
kickoff.why: One L4 covers both towers at peak; the second is redundancy, one per zone.

kickoff.label: Reranker L4s (top-k text)
kickoff.why: The cost driver: rerank depth decides whether the budget holds (top-100 needs 24).

check.label: Compute fits under the US$20k/month budget

kickoff.label: Error budget (30 days)
kickoff.why: Minutes of non-BM25-covered downtime the month allows.

datos.label: Judgments per round
datos.why: Graded labels behind NDCG@10; one round per quarter and per new model.

datos.label: Cost per judgment round
datos.why: Part of the ≈ US$6–7k each model change costs.

datos.label: Query–contact pairs per day
datos.why: Free fine-tuning signal, biased to what the old ranker showed.

versionado.label: FP32 vectors per version in S3
versionado.why: Keeping every version is negligible: rebuild an index without GPUs.

re-embedding.label: Re-embedding GPU-hours (both towers)

re-embedding.label: Wall clock on the job fleet
re-embedding.why: A planned event of hours, not minutes: no need for more GPUs.

re-embedding.label: Re-embedding GPU cost (on-demand)
re-embedding.why: Under US$20: spot does not justify interruptions on a 3 h job.

re-embedding.label: CPU cores to feed the job fleet
re-embedding.why: JPEG decode is the bottleneck (4 vCPU per g6.xlarge): plan CPU or DALI.

indice-green.label: Graph + int8 per shard (with overhead)
indice-green.why: The traversed set must be in RAM: a page fault mid-graph is a disk read.

indice-green.label: FP32 rescoring vectors per shard
indice-green.why: Served from page cache on gp3; a new copy must prewarm this before traffic.

indice-green.label: RAM used per data node
indice-green.why: Picks the r7i.4xlarge (128 GiB) over a bigger or smaller box.

indice-green.label: Node memory utilization
indice-green.why: Headroom for merges that build new graphs and catalog growth.

serving.label: ANN cores per node, one copy down
serving.why: ANN is memory-bound: if CPU were short, add copies, not shards.

check.label: One copy carries the full peak on 16 vCPU

serving.label: FP32 rescoring reads per node
serving.why: Far above the 40k IOPS EBS ceiling: FP32 must sit in page cache.

serving.label: Reranker utilization, one L4 down
serving.why: At the edge of the 70 % plan: the query cache provides the margin, else a 9th L4.

kubernetes.label: Reranker utilization, all up

kickoff.label: Pieces per line per day
kickoff.why: The line is a clock: design per piece period, not for a QPS peak.

kickoff.label: Defects per line per day
kickoff.why: Bounds escapes and the label flow.

kickoff.label: Decision deadline after trigger
kickoff.why: Hard budget for camera + model + write; PLC owns the last 150 ms.

kickoff.label: Typical loop path
kickoff.why: Typical case uses ≈ 60 % of the deadline; the rest is for the tail.

check.label: Typical path within ≈ 60 % of the deadline

kickoff.label: Margin for the tail
kickoff.why: Absorbs thermal throttling, Python pauses and GigE resends.

kickoff.label: Jetson GPU occupancy per line
kickoff.why: Sized for deterministic latency, not throughput: one device per line.

kickoff.label: Inspector re-inspection capacity
kickoff.why: Capacity, not re-inspection cost, sets the FP budget.

kickoff.label: Hard false-positive budget
kickoff.why: Ceiling the threshold tool may never cross.

check.label: FP target under the inspector-capacity ceiling

kickoff.label: Diverted pieces per line per day
kickoff.why: Bin load and the image volume to store.

kickoff.label: Inspector load at the FP target
kickoff.why: At ≈ 60 % the inspector absorbs variation; at 2.8 % FP it would be ≈ 100 %.

kickoff.label: Uplink if the plant inferred in the cloud
kickoff.why: Sustained 320 Mb/s on a link that drops rules out cloud inference.

kickoff.label: Hardware amortized + cloud
kickoff.why: The business case is escapes avoided, not cost per prediction.

check.label: One avoided escape a month pays for it

datos.label: Resolution on the part
datos.why: Picks camera and lens before any model choice.

datos.label: Max exposure for ≤ 1 px motion blur
datos.why: Global shutter + synchronized strobe, not ambient light.

datos.label: Approved-piece sample per line
datos.why: Escape-hunting sample and clean "good" data for the anomaly model.

datos.label: Inspector labeling time per line
datos.why: The cheapest label: one tap on a piece already being inspected.

versionado.label: Decision records per line
versionado.why: Immutable lineage for every piece is cheap; keep it all.

gate.label: Defects per type to claim the recall
gate.why: Rule of three: 0 misses in n proves ≥ 1 − 3/n at 95 %.

gate.label: Recall with one miss in today's set
gate.why: The pilot set cannot prove 99.5 %: collect in shadow first.

gate.label: Escapes per line per day at target
gate.why: FN cost dominates at every operating point.

export.label: Crack width in pixels
export.why: Full resolution in tiles; if too thin, fix optics, not the model.

export.label: Crack width if downscaled to 1,024 px
export.why: Why the image is never resized: the crack vanishes.

export.label: Tiles per image (fixed batch)
export.why: Fixed engine shape: one profile, batch = tiles.

serving.label: GigE transfer per image
serving.why: Almost all of acquisition: dedicated NIC with jumbo frames.

serving.label: Latest frame arrival before an immediate DIVERT
serving.why: Deadline-guard threshold in app.py: skip inference, keep up with the next piece.

check.label: Normal acquisition lands before the cutoff

serving.label: Typical path if two lines shared a Jetson
serving.why: Leaves ≈ 30 ms for the tail: one device per line.

rollout.label: Pieces in one shadow shift (line 1)
rollout.why: Sample the challenger logs before it may decide on line 1.

rollout.label: Defects expected in one shadow shift
rollout.why: Defects the shadow shift compares: promotion needs none lost vs the champion.

request.label: Time between pieces
request.why: No dynamic batching: batching two pieces means waiting 500 ms.

request.label: Camera → Jetson average per line
request.why: Dedicated camera port, separate from the PLC network.

plc-con-default-seguro.label: part_id wrap-around time
plc-con-default-seguro.why: PLC clears the register after use so a stale PASS never matches.

plc-con-default-seguro.label: Pieces diverted per hour with Jetson or PLC link down
plc-con-default-seguro.why: Fail-safe default means the line effectively stops: page immediately.

plc-con-default-seguro.label: Inspector capacity per hour
plc-con-default-seguro.why: What a divert-all can be compared against: 30× over.

monitoreo.label: Pieces above a p99 per line-day
monitoreo.why: SLO is deadline misses ≈ 0 plus p99.9 and max per shift, not p99.

monitoreo.label: Error-DIVERT alert threshold
monitoreo.why: rate() threshold for camera, image and engine DIVERT reasons.

monitoreo.label: Inspector load per hour in a 2× reject spike
monitoreo.why: RejectRateSpike means light, lens or focus: the bin overflows.

monitoreo.label: Bin backlog growth in the spike
monitoreo.why: Time to act before someone returns parts unchecked.

store-and-forward-a-la-nube.label: Local data per line per day
Buffer for 72 h offline per line
store-and-forward-a-la-nube.why: Fits the device NVMe; the plant server keeps weeks.

store-and-forward-a-la-nube.label: Plant upload, 24 h average
store-and-forward-a-la-nube.why: Steady upload volume ≈ 69 GB/day: bandwidth-capped during shifts.

store-and-forward-a-la-nube.label: Catch-up after 72 h without link
store-and-forward-a-la-nube.why: How long the cloud lags after an outage; records upload first.
